title: rwb-partner interaction-ledger slice: no ledger column or operation in S9, no published payload for EV-20 or EV-21, the seam with RWB-P2-E2034-CON undefined, the list members, the retry bound and the holder-reference form unpublished, and an empty H row against ten platform contracts
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R7.2, R7.3 and R9; context pack S9 rwb-partner (service row, ownership rows: tables partner, partner_instruction, partner_user; events EV-20, EV-21; workflow InstructionWorkflow; slides 2, 4, 5, 8 and 12); split plan story line RWB-S9-E2034-APP; legacy RWB-E2-034 sections 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 14 and 16; FSD S9 Partner management v3 A1.2, A2.5 and A2.6; TSD S9 Partner management v2 T3.1, T3.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1; sibling stories RWB-S9-E6033-APP and RWB-S9-E2033-CON (AD022)
description: (1) No ledger estate in S9: the Ownership Map gives rwb-partner three tables, six instruction operations, two events and one workflow, and no interaction, retention or ledger read, so the ledger, its retention class and its ordered read are rwb-source-data's by the default ruling while this service can only publish the partner fact. (2) No published payload: no source prints the property list, the schema subject or the envelope element names of EV-20 InstructionIssued or EV-21 PartnerResultSubmitted; the token lists seen in sibling story baselines differ, and the seven ledger attributes this story adds are named by no document. (3) Undefined seam: RWB-P2-E2034-CON is the contract of this legacy key in rwb-integration, but no row of it names the partner facts, the consumer element or the composed timeline in a published form, and the Work Package fixes it as the C row while the mapping itself is another service's. (4) Unpublished values: the rows of LOV-LEDGER-EVENT, LOV-CHANNEL, LOV-DIRECTION and LOV-SOURCE, the retry bound of the outbox and the form of the holder reference USER:<id> and PARTNER:<code> are used by the legacy story as values and are published by no list or parameter row. (5) No contact column: partner_instruction holds no contact_key (TSD S9 T3.1), so the contact reference of legacy BR5 cannot be carried by this service and must be resolved by the ledger owner through rwb-source-data. (6) Empty H row against ten platform contracts: DP-03, DP-06, DP-07, DP-08, DP-09, DP-10, DP-11, DP-13, DP-15 and DP-19 each add a platform or cross-service dependency, while the Work Package gives the story H None and C RWB-P2-E2034-CON.
evidence: Context pack ownership rows for S9: tables partner, partner_instruction, partner_user; REST operations GET /partner/instructions, GET /partners, POST /cases/{caseId}/instructions, POST /partner/instructions/{instructionId}/accept, POST /partner/instructions/{instructionId}/invoices, POST /partner/instructions/{instructionId}/results; events EV-20 and EV-21; jobs 0; workflow InstructionWorkflow. TSD S9 T3.1 partner_instruction fields DF-PRT-008 to DF-PRT-016, with no contact or ledger column. TSD S9 T-A.1 API-S9-001 to API-S9-006, with no interaction operation. Legacy RWB-E2-034 section 12 names v_ace_efs_action, v_ace_contact and the GET /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/interactions read, none of which S9 owns. Sibling RWB-S9-E6033-APP section 12.3 publishes EV-21 with a different element list from section 12.3 of this story.
area: S9 rwb-partner; interaction ledger; events EV-20 and EV-21; contract with P2 rwb-integration
owner_role: Solution architect; rwb-integration contract owner (RWB-P2-E2034-CON); rwb-source-data ledger owner
proposed: The partner fact, its seven ledger attributes, the transaction rule and the read-only view are declared here with placeholders; the payload element names and the seam with RWB-P2-E2034-CON are agreed at that contract's review, and no ledger row, retention class or timeline read is claimed by this service.
